metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Formal Specification
metadata.description: Program Graph formal specification for the zERC20 multi-chain privacy token protocol. This system enables private ERC20 transfers using Nova folding schemes and Groth16 proofs, with cross-chain coordination via LayerZero v2.

trusted_entities.description: External user interacting with the protocol via CLI or dApp to perform wraps, unwraps, transfers, and private teleports.
Upgradeable ERC-20 implementation that enforces value <= 2^248-1 for BN254 scalar field compatibility. Maintains SHA-256 hash chain for transfer history and emits IndexedTransfer events.

LayerZero OApp managing Nova/Groth16 proof validation and cross-chain coordination. Records hash chain checkpoints, validates transfer root proofs, verifies withdrawal proofs, and relays proved roots to Hub.
Central aggregation point tracking per-token transfer roots and monotonic tree indices. Computes PoseidonT3 aggregation trees and broadcasts global roots to verifiers.
Sole liquidity authority for minting/burning zERC20. Implements incentive curves for wrap rewards and unwrap fees, anchoring supply to underlying reserves.
Cross-chain exit coordination using Stargate bridge transport. Preserves user intent through slippage limits and refund mechanisms.

Privileged EOA or multisig with onlyOwner access to critical protocol functions. Can register/update tokens in Hub, rotate verifiers, update fee parameters, set minter addresses, and upgrade contract implementations. All administrative actions take effect immediately with no timelock. Key compromise enables complete protocol takeover including fund theft via malicious upgrades or verifier rotation.
Off-chain service that indexes zERC20 transfer events and generates Merkle proofs for historical transfers. Provides tree index lookups and batch proof generation.
Off-chain service that converts Nova IVC folding proofs into Groth16 final proofs for on-chain verification.
Cross-chain messaging protocol enabling reliable message passing between Hub and Verifier contracts across different EVM chains.
Cross-chain liquidity bridge used by Adaptor for asset transfers between chains.
Internet Computer canister managing stealth address secrets for privacy-preserving operations.
Internet Computer canister providing encrypted state storage for user data.
ZK-friendly hash function implementation using light-poseidon library with circom-compatible configurations (PoseidonT2 and PoseidonT3).
Elliptic curve operations on the Baby JubJub curve (embedded in BN254) for zkSNARK-friendly cryptographic operations.
Incrementally verifiable computation circuit using sonobe/folding-schemes library for efficient proof aggregation.

data_structures.name: zERC20 Token
data_structures.description: Privacy-enabled ERC20 token with value constrained to <= 2^248-1 for BN254 field compatibility. Tracks balances, allowances, and transfer history via hash chain.

data_structures.name: SHA-256 Hash Chain
data_structures.description: Truncated 248-bit SHA-256 hash chain appending (to, value) for each transfer. Provides deterministic commitment to transfer history.

data_structures.name: IndexedTransfer Event
data_structures.description: Event emitted on each transfer containing: index (incrementing counter), from address, to address, value. Used by indexer to build Merkle trees.

data_structures.name: Transfer Root
data_structures.description: Merkle root of indexed transfers at a given index. Used as public input for Nova proofs and stored in provedTransferRoots mapping.

data_structures.name: Global Transfer Root
data_structures.description: Hub-aggregated root combining transfer roots from all registered tokens across chains. Stored in globalTransferRoots mapping.

data_structures.name: PoseidonT3 Aggregation Root
data_structures.description: Root of height-6 Poseidon tree aggregating up to 64 token transfer roots. Computed by Hub during broadcast.

data_structures.name: Nova IVC Proof
data_structures.description: Incrementally verifiable computation proof generated via Nova folding scheme. Proves transitions from oldRoot to newRoot using reserved checkpoint as public input.

data_structures.name: Groth16 Final Proof
data_structures.description: Succinct zkSNARK proof generated from Nova IVC proof. Verifiable on-chain via Solidity verifier contract.

data_structures.name: GeneralRecipient
data_structures.description: Encoded recipient structure containing: chain_id, address, tweak plus version byte. Used for cross-chain recipient validation in proofs.

data_structures.name: Stealth Burn Address
data_structures.description: Derived address computed from secret using compute_burn_address_from_secret(). Requires proof-of-work validation.

data_structures.name: Historical Merkle Proof
data_structures.description: Proof structure containing: target_index, leaf_index, root, hash_chain, siblings[]. Provides Merkle inclusion proof for historical transfers.

data_structures.name: Incentive Curve Parameters
data_structures.description: Linear density curve parameters: k (basis point strength), T (target liquidity). Used for calculating wrap rewards and unwrap fees.

data_structures.name: Wrap Request
data_structures.description: Request to convert underlying tokens to zERC20. Contains: amount, recipient. Triggers reward calculation and minting.

data_structures.name: Unwrap Request
data_structures.description: Request to convert zERC20 to underlying tokens. Contains: amount, recipient. Triggers fee calculation and burning.

data_structures.name: Teleport Request
data_structures.description: Privacy-preserving transfer request with zkSNARK proof. Contains: proof data, recipient hash, transfer root reference, amount delta.

data_structures.name: Reserved Hash Chain Checkpoint
data_structures.description: Snapshot of zERC20 state at reservation time. Maps index to (index, hashChain) pair for proof public input binding.

data_structures.name: LayerZero Cross-Chain Message
data_structures.description: Message structure for Hub-Verifier communication. Contains: eid (endpoint ID), payload, options. Requires supermajority guardian signing.

data_structures.name: Token Registration Info
data_structures.description: Hub registry entry for registered tokens. Contains: chain EID, token address, verifier address, capacity limits.

data_structures.name: Stargate Bridge Parameters
data_structures.description: Parameters for cross-chain bridging via Adaptor. Contains: destination chain, slippage limits, refund address.

data_structures.name: SecretAndTweak Structure
data_structures.description: Derived cryptographic values for burn address generation. Contains: secret (PoW-adjusted), tweak (keccak256 derived). Used in stealth address computation.

data_structures.name: Full Burn Address
data_structures.description: Complete stealth burn address structure containing: GeneralRecipient, secret. Serializable with version byte prefix (105 bytes total).

data_structures.name: Proof-of-Work Nonce
data_structures.description: Nonce value found via find_pow_nonce() that when combined with secret_seed produces a valid burn address secret.

data_structures.name: Poseidon Sponge State
data_structures.description: Internal state of Poseidon hash function containing field elements being hashed. Uses rate-1 sponge construction.

data_structures.name: BN254 Scalar Field Element (Fr)
data_structures.description: Element of the BN254 scalar field used for all ZK circuit computations. 254-bit value representing a point coordinate or scalar.

data_structures.name: Nova IVC State Vector
data_structures.description: State vector for Nova IVC containing: [merkle_root, recipient, total_value, delta]. Updated after each folding step.

data_structures.name: Withdraw External Inputs
data_structures.description: Per-step external inputs for Nova withdraw circuit: is_dummy, from_address, value, secret, leaf_index, siblings[].

data_structures.name: Adaptor Bridge Request
data_structures.description: Request structure for Stargate bridging: dstEid, to, minAmountOut, extraOptions, composeMsg, oftCmd.

data_structures.name: Adaptor Fee Quote
data_structures.description: Fee breakdown from Adaptor: tokenUnwrapFee, nativeBridgeFee, tokenBridgeFee. Used for user quote display.

data_structures.name: VetKey Derived Secret
data_structures.description: Secret derived from IC VetKey infrastructure for stealth address management. Uses vetKd_derive_key canister call.

data_structures.name: IC Encrypted State
data_structures.description: AES-GCM encrypted user state stored in IC Storage canister. Contains serialized payment advice and invoice data.

sub_graphs.title: SelfCall Utility Pattern for Reentrancy Prevention

incentive_lib_computeIncentive.name: IncentiveLib.computeIncentive
incentive_lib_computeIncentive.description: Linear density function for calculating wrap rewards and unwrap fees based on liquidity position relative to target.

mathematical_definition.density_function: ρ(x) = k × (1 - x/T) where k = basis point strength, T = target liquidity, x = current liquidity position
mathematical_definition.wrap_reward_integral: R(L, amount) = ∫[L to L+amount] ρ(x) dx = k × amount × (1 - (2L + amount) / (2T))
mathematical_definition.unwrap_fee_integral: F(L, amount) = ∫[L-amount to L] ρ(x) dx = k × amount × (1 - (2L - amount) / (2T))
mathematical_definition.boundary_clamping: Integration bounds are clamped to [0, T] to prevent negative values

rounding_rules.wrap_rewards: Floor rounding - protocol never overpays rewards
rounding_rules.unwrap_fees: Ceiling rounding - protocol never undercollects fees

overflow_prevention.multiplication_order: Compute k × amount first, then divide to minimize precision loss
overflow_prevention.safe_math: All operations use unchecked blocks only where overflow is impossible
overflow_prevention.max_values: amount and L constrained to prevent uint256 overflow

edge_cases.amount_exceeds_L: For unwrap, clamped to available liquidity
